description: Permanently delete a file from an inbox's drive (Agent Drive); this cannot be undone. Its path is free at once and its space returns to the quota within seconds, but a download link handed out before keeps working until it expires, at most an hour. Agent Drive is in AgentMail Labs (US only); an organization outside Labs gets a 403.

fileId.description: File ID, from upload_file or list_files

inboxId.description: Inbox ID: the inbox's email address, from list_inboxes
